name: Springhall's Goddess
source:
Melodia and her sisters are Harvest-Goddess'-in-training, and to become a full fledged Harvest Goddess, they each must revive a town. Take on the role of Melodia, the bubbly Harvest Goddess tasked with saving Springhall, a once prosperous town that has slowly been deteriorating since its previous Harvest Goddess abandoned it many years ago. On her journey to save the town, Melodia can make friends, enemies, and may even find a special someone along the way!

[From [url=https://fluffifae.itch.io/springhalls-goddess]itch.io[/url]]
